english_paragraphs: In a 1955 referendum, about 83 per cent of voters chose to keep driving on the left, an overwhelmingly clear rejection of change. On 10 May 1963, however, legislators in parliament overruled the electorate, approving right-hand traffic from 1967 in defiance of a populace among whom the plan was unpopular.

The case rested on conformity. Norway and Finland drove on the right, with about five million border crossings a year, so a left-hand orientation meant isolation and inconvenient journeys. Safety favoured alignment too. About 90 per cent of cars were left-hand drive, so motorists overtaking on narrow two-lane highways risked head-on collisions.

A state body ran the mammoth preparation under a logo, a large H with an arrow. Its propaganda included a song contest on television, and the winning jingle, whose lyrics urged people to keep right, reached fifth in the chart. Some 360,000 items of signage were changed, and a massive fleet of over 1,000 new buses with right-hand doors was procured.

The transition came on Sunday 3 September 1967. A curfew kept non-essential vehicles off the asphalt from one to six, with essential traffic exempt. At ten to five, all traffic stopped and crawled across, restarting at five, before dawn, with its direction flipped. Stockholm and Malmö had a longer closure, from Saturday morning to Sunday afternoon, while crews reconfigured junctions.

On the following Monday, 125 accidents were reported, against 130 to 198 on earlier Mondays, a statistical improvement put down to the heightened care of hesitant drivers. The nervousness apparently subsided and prudent habits faded, for by 1969 accident and fatality rates had reverted to their baseline.
chinese_paragraphs: 1955年瑞典举行公投，约83%的投票者选择保留靠左行驶，以压倒性多数拒绝改变。然而，1963年5月10日，议会推翻选民的选择，不顾这项计划在民众中缺乏支持，批准自1967年起改为靠右行驶。
改制的理由是与邻国统一。挪威和芬兰都靠右行驶，每年约有500万次跨境通行，瑞典靠左便带来隔阂和出行不便。安全也支持统一：约90%的汽车方向盘位于左侧，司机在狭窄的双车道公路上超车时，容易面临迎面相撞的危险。
一个国家机构负责这项庞大的准备工程，以带箭头的大写H为标识。宣传还包括电视歌曲比赛，获胜的广告歌用歌词劝人靠右行驶，甚至登上歌曲排行榜第五名。约36万件道路标识被更换，1000多辆右侧开门的新公交车也采购到位。
切换在1967年9月3日星期日进行。凌晨1点至6点，非必要车辆不得上路，必要车辆获得豁免。4点50分，仍在路上的车辆全部停下，再缓缓移到另一侧；5点、天亮之前，车辆统一按相反的行驶侧重新出发。斯德哥尔摩和马尔默的封路时间更长，从周六上午到周日下午，施工人员在此期间改造交叉路口。
随后的星期一报告了125起事故，此前的星期一则有130至198起。这一统计上的改善，被归因于司机对新制度尚不熟悉，开车格外小心。紧张感似乎后来消退了，谨慎习惯也随之淡去：到1969年，事故率和死亡率已回到原来的基准水平。

cover_question: 全国换边行驶，怎样在一个清晨完成？
reading_note: 左侧方向盘与靠左行驶不是一回事；首个周一事故少，并不意味着长期事故率持续下降。
illustration_prompt:
Create a single publication-quality landscape 3:2 narrative illustration for an adult illustrated English-reading booklet. Finished standalone artwork, not a book mockup, not a collage of multiple unrelated panels. Sophisticated contemporary editorial gouache and watercolor, carefully controlled colored-pencil accents, velvety matte paint, subtle warm paper texture, soft natural daylight. Warm ivory paper dominates; subdued eucalyptus and sage greens structure the composition; restrained buttery lemon-yellow and dusty terracotta accents. Calm, comfortable, refined, credible drawing and natural anatomy. An airy coherent composition with one clear story focal point and at most two supporting details, generous breathing room at all edges and softly feathered painted edges into ivory. Detailed but uncluttered. Historically and scientifically appropriate objects, clothing and setting. Show the particular article's pivotal event or mechanism rather than a generic portrait or generic textbook symbols. Human figures treated with dignity; no grotesque caricature, no sensational violence or visible injuries. For disasters, emphasize the setting, evidence or human response without graphic suffering. For uncertain scientific claims, depict the observations and investigation without presenting debated mechanisms as proven. Absolutely no typography, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, diagram labels, fake writing or invented charts anywhere. Do not render invisible forces as literal magic. Avoid corporate vector icons, slick 3D rendering and childish cartoon style. High-quality, print-ready visual storytelling, matching a warm ivory-and-sage adult watercolor booklet.

Specific scene: The calm dawn AFTER Sweden's September 1967 change to right-hand traffic, a restrained bird's-eye three-quarter view of one simple two-lane street bending through modest Nordic town buildings. A period 1960s Volvo-style car and a cream-and-sage bus move AWAY on the RIGHT-hand half of the road; one oncoming period car uses the LEFT-hand half in the image, correctly on its own right. Clear center line, no crossing or collision, very few vehicles. A road worker stands safely on the sidewalk with a plain lowered flag; a few cones recall the supervised transition. Right-side bus doors are appropriate. No signs with lettering, dates, numbers, logos, road slogans or written arrows; architectural shapes and coherent correct traffic directions carry the story. Misty ivory dawn, adult watercolor.
EDIT THIS ATTACHED ARTWORK, preserving the exact successful composition, soft watercolor style, all cars and their right-hand-traffic directions. Correct only the bus: the visible side of the bus faces the road center and is its LEFT side, so it must NOT have a passenger folding door. Remove the visible folding passenger door near the rear on that side and replace it with a continuous sage lower body panel and ordinary side passenger windows. The bus passenger entry doors are on the opposite RIGHT side facing the far sidewalk and are naturally hidden from this rear-left viewpoint. Do not add any visible door on the rear. Keep the recognizable rear window and tail lamps, no text or logos. This is a small vehicle anatomy correction, not a new scene.

1955年公投约83%反对改靠右，议会仍于1963年批准改制，定在1967年实施。
政府广泛宣传，更换约36万件道路标识，购置1,000多辆右侧开门的公交车，并在切换期间限制非必要车辆上路。
1967年9月3日4点50分，车辆停下后缓缓移到另一侧，5点统一靠右出发；部分城市另封路改造路口。
切换后首个周一事故减少，被归因于司机格外谨慎；但到1969年，事故率和死亡率都回到原有水平。
